name: Odapipam
summary: Odapipam is a selective D1 receptor antagonist of the benzazepine group which was investigated as a potential antipsychotic but was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: Odapipam (INN; developmental code names NNC 01-0756, NNC-756, NO-756) is a selective D1 receptor antagonist of the benzazepine group which was investigated as a potential antipsychotic but was never marketed. It has more than 5,000-fold selectivity for the dopamine D1 receptor (Ki = 0.17 nM) over the dopamine D2 receptor (Ki = 942 nM).

uses.text: Odapipam (INN; developmental code names NNC 01-0756, NNC-756, NO-756) is a selective D1 receptor antagonist of the benzazepine group which was investigated as a potential antipsychotic but was never marketed.

fact.en: It blocks the D1 dopamine receptor rather than D2, the usual target of antipsychotics, and such drugs turned out not to control psychosis well, which taught researchers a lot about which receptor matters.
fact.zh: 它阻斷的是 D1 多巴胺受體，而非抗精神病藥常見的 D2 標的。這類藥物最終對精神病症狀控制不佳，卻讓研究者更了解哪個受體才是關鍵。
fact.zhHans: 它阻断的是 D1 多巴胺受体，而非抗精神病药常见的 D2 标的。这类药物最终对精神病症状控制不佳，却让研究者更了解哪个受体才是关键。
